name: critbot-desktop
description: Critbot as a Mac menubar + desktop app — the live experience packaged, relay hosted in-process.
comment: extraResources ships the relay + web app inside the .app. Note: packaging an in-process Node relay requires the require() paths to resolve at runtime; if a packaged build can't find ../live, point main.js at the extraResources path (process.resourcesPath + '/core/live/relay.js'). Dev (`npm start`) runs from source and needs no path tweaks.
